subjects.PROP-CANDLEBOX-01: PROP-CANDLEBOX-01_author_closed_and_open.png — AUTHOR-SUPPLIED plate of Бабушка-Яга's candle box in BOTH states on white: at the left the plain brown card box shut with its lid on; at the right the same box open, lid hinged back, holding SEVEN striped birthday candles laid flat in a row — pink, yellow, green, blue, purple, orange, blue.
subjects.PROP-TEA-01: PROP-TEA-01_author_thimble_and_kettle.png — AUTHOR-SUPPLIED plate of the tea props on white: the dimpled metal thimble used as a drinking cup, and the small brass kettle with a wooden handle grip and wooden lid knob.

rulings.twoStatesAreTheShot: The candle box is the object that CHANGES in the shot-7-to-shot-8 interpolation, and this plate supplies both its start state (shut) and its end state (open, candles visible). Bind it to that job as a reference alongside the two frames.
rulings.sevenCandles: SEVEN candles, matching Фрося's seventh birthday. The count is carried by the picture; Яга's line no longer names it.
rulings.teaPropsCarryTheAction: The kettle and the thimble-cup are the objects that move in the shot-3 interpolation — he lifts the kettle, she raises her cup. Neither had a plate before this.
